The *Samādhipañha* ("The Question on Samādhi", Mil 3.1.14) is a text in the *Milindapañha* collection. It is available in modern translation in three languages, including an English translation by John Kelly.

A full parallel to the dialogue is preserved in the Chinese Buddhist canon as T 1670b 2.13 (*Concentration*). In addition, the text shares thematic connections or is noted as mentioned in canonical and post-canonical treatises, including the *Cetanākaraṇīyasutta* (AN 11.2), three canonical discourses titled *Samādhisutta* (SN 22.5, SN 35.99, and SN 56.1), the *Paññattihāravibhaṅga* of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 14), and the *Hāravibhaṅgapañcamabhūmi* of the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 5).
